summary: Root cause confirmed at reconcile-task-status.sh:186-195: handoff_permits_promotion() permits on a missing handoff but refuses on any off-vocabulary status via strict equality, wedging the task. Recommended fix: treat off-vocabulary status as equivalent to missing (permit, deferring to artifact evidence) with a mandatory loud diagnostic; keep refusing on-vocabulary non-matching statuses unchanged. Also found a second call site (partial branch, lines 433-442) needing the same consolidation.
decisions_made: Off-vocabulary handoff status treated as equivalent to missing handoff (permit + loud diagnostic), not refused and not synonym-normalized
orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh is out of scope -- it serves a different call site (missing/stale handoff) with a deliberately narrower policy
partial branch's inline duplicate check (lines 433-442) must be consolidated into handoff_permits_promotion for consistency
dead_ends: Rejected refuse-with-diagnostic-only: preserves the wedge, only adds visibility
Rejected synonym-normalization table: incomplete by construction, risks false-positive promotion
